wan.notes: Not applicable - no WAN interface in this profile.

lan.notes: Wi-Fi and Ethernet backhaul both supported; at least one Ethernet port recommended for wired backhaul option.

wifi.notes: Wi-Fi AP fronthaul mandatory for extender role.

easyMesh.notes: EasyMesh R6 Agent-Only role and IEEE 1905 transport are both mandatory for this profile.

bluetoothIot.notes: Same IoT feature set as EthWAN WiFi Router applies if enabled on the extender.

storageInterface.notes: A/B partition layout recommended for OTA.

mediaTuner.notes: Not applicable - no WAN, voice, or tuner hardware in scope for the extender role.

diagnostics.notes: Typically not needed on an EasyMesh extender per component notes; UART/debug console recommended for bring-up.
